# Innovate Deck

> Deck builder serving Massachusetts, New Hampshire, Rhode Island and Southern Maine. Custom composite and wood decks, deck repair and restoration, railings and stairs, porches and screened porches, pergolas and outdoor living spaces. Free estimates. Innovate Deck is operated by Innovate Building Inc.

- Phone: (781) 528-0069 (call or text)
- Email: support@innovatedecks.com
- Hours: Mon-Fri 7am-6pm, Sat 8am-4pm
- Free estimate: https://innovatedeck.com/contact

- [Composite decking](https://innovatedeck.com/services/composite-decking)
- [Wood decking](https://innovatedeck.com/services/wood-decking)

- [Railings & stairs](https://innovatedeck.com/services/railings-stairs)
